question: If $\begin{vmatrix}x&3\\2&x\end{vmatrix}=10$, determine all possible values of $x$. Hence, calculate their sum and product.
explanation:
Expansion of the determinant
$$\begin{vmatrix}x&3\\2&x\end{vmatrix}=x^2-6$$
Formation of the equation
Using the given value, $$x^2-6=10$$ Therefore, $$x^2=16$$
Determination of the values
Thus, $$x=4\quad\text{or}\quad x=-4$$
Sum and product
Their sum is $4+(-4)=0$, and their product is $$(4)(-4)=-16$$
